teiku-tekuru.mnemonic_text: Koichi waves off the empty delivery truck, "<reading>Take you</reading> away!", and it goes, <grammar>moving away</grammar>. Then the <reading>tech crew</reading> comes in with a new fridge, <grammar>coming closer</grammar> step by step. 弟が出<reading>ていって</reading>、また帰っ<reading>てくる</reading>。

temo.mnemonic_text: Rain pours on the sports field, but the coach just yells "<reading>Ten more!</reading>", and Sei keeps running laps <grammar>even though</grammar> she is soaked to the bone. 寒く<reading>ても</reading>、学校に行く。

souni-naru.mnemonic_text: Chuu the mouse claws up the mountain trail to one step below the vending machine, then slides to the bottom. He squeaks "<reading>So near</reading>!": he <grammar>almost</grammar> made it. 落ち<reading>そうになる</reading>。

youda.mnemonic_text: Sei follows muddy paw prints from the window to an empty fish plate. She calls "<reading>Yo, Dad</reading>": <grammar>judging by the clues, it seems</grammar> the cat ate it. 猫が魚を食べた<reading>ようだ</reading>。

mitai.mnemonic_text: Dai the giant baby knots a bath towel under his chins and gurgles "<reading>Me tie</reading>". With a rattle for a pen, he <grammar>kind of seems like</grammar> an office worker. 赤ちゃんは会社員<reading>みたいだ</reading>。

teiru-result.mnemonic_text: Grandma Kane's cats crack a shrine window at dawn and stroll in. By dusk they still own every cushion, and she sighs "<reading>They rule</reading>": it <grammar>happened, and it is still so</grammar>. 窓が壊れ<reading>ている</reading>。

tearu.mnemonic_text: Sho the tiny magician sets a tiara on the empty stage, whispers "<reading>Tiara</reading>" and walks off. It sits there all night, <grammar>placed on purpose</grammar>. テーブルに帽子が置い<reading>てある</reading>。

causative.mnemonic_text: Koichi ties an apron on a stray cat, points at the konbini till and barks "<reading>Sah, sell!</reading>": he <grammar>makes someone else do</grammar> the work. 弟に部屋を掃除<reading>させる</reading>。

causative-passive.mnemonic_text: In the school hallway, Jin the giant props a heavy door open with little Lou all afternoon. He rumbles "<reading>Sorry, Lou</reading>", because Lou is <grammar>made to do it, against his will</grammar>. 私は友達に待た<reading>される</reading>。

youni.mnemonic_text: On the mountain trail, Toto the turtle pats his leg and says "<reading>Yo, knee</reading>" as he tapes a cushion on. It is padded <grammar>so that</grammar> he can crawl to the vending machine at the top. 忘れない<reading>ように</reading>、手に書く。

youninaru.mnemonic_text: All summer Nina rides her bicycle off the bank into the river. Tonight she pedals straight across the bridge, and the fishermen yell "<reading>Yo, Nina rules!</reading>": she has <grammar>come to be able to</grammar> do it. 妹は自転車に乗れる<reading>ようになりました</reading>。

younaru.mnemonic_text: Roo, the pigeon on Grandma Kane's shrine bell, cooed every dawn for years. Since the cats moved in, Grandma just sighs "<reading>Nah, coo? Nah, Roo</reading>": he <grammar>no longer coos</grammar>. 兄はお酒を飲ま<reading>なくなる</reading>。

hazu.mnemonic_text: The onigiri truck left at six and the drive takes one hour. Koichi checks the till clock and announces "It <reading>has</reading> to be here": it <grammar>should be</grammar> at the door by now. 明日は雨が降る<reading>はず</reading>です。

hazuganai.mnemonic_text: A crow tells Chuu the loyal mouse that the whole zoo flew away overnight. Chuu, who walked past its gates at dawn, snorts "<reading>Hah! Zoo gone? Nay!</reading>": there is <grammar>no way</grammar>, it <grammar>can't be</grammar>. 猫が泳ぐ<reading>はずがない</reading>。

rashii.mnemonic_text: Ken the shiba presses a paw to the red dots on Dai the giant baby's arm and barks "<reading>Rash, see?</reading>" at the nurse. By noon the whole town has heard that Dai <grammar>seems to be</grammar> ill. 彼は病気<reading>らしい</reading>。

ba.mnemonic_text: Koichi glues one-yen tags on every rice ball and grunts "<reading>Bah!</reading>", his whole shop law: <grammar>if</grammar> it is cheap, it sells. 安けれ<reading>ば</reading>、買います。

nara.mnemonic_text: A lady tells Toto the door-selling turtle she needs a bathroom door. He slides the thinnest one off his shell and says "<reading>Narro</reading>w, then!": <grammar>if it is the bathroom</grammar>, this one. 魚<reading>なら</reading>、あの店がいいです。

potential.mnemonic_text: Sho's dove flops out of his tiny hat onto the stage. He bows, squeaks "<reading>Rerun!</reading>", and on the second go it flies: he <grammar>can do it</grammar>. 僕は走<reading>れる</reading>。

passive.mnemonic_text: At the riverbank, a duck bumps Ken the dog into the water. He climbs out dripping and growls "<reading>Rail</reading>roaded!": that was <grammar>done to him</grammar>. 弟に笑わ<reading>れる</reading>。

ka-douka.mnemonic_text: At Koichi's beeping till, a shaky customer holds up a bent card and asks "<reading>Card, OK?</reading>", because nobody knows <grammar>whether or not</grammar> it will work. 彼が来る<reading>かどうか</reading>分からない。

ka-nanka.mnemonic_text: Ken the shiba digs a rusty lump out of the riverbank mud, sniffs it once and declares it a "<reading>harmonica</reading>", <grammar>or something</grammar>. お茶<reading>か何か</reading>飲みます。

toka.mnemonic_text: The coach yells "<reading>Tow car!</reading>" across the sports field. A truck drags off a bench, a goat, a tuba, <grammar>things like that and so on</grammar>. 肉<reading>とか</reading>魚<reading>とか</reading>食べます。

kke2.mnemonic_text: Han the half-and-half chef serves one bowl of "<reading>ramen</reading>": its left side is boiling, <grammar>while at the same time</grammar> its right side is frozen solid. この店は安い<reading>反面</reading>、遠い。

saichuu-ni.mnemonic_text: Jin the giant is halfway through a bowl of noodles. A sneeze bursts out, "<reading>Sigh-CHOO!</reading>", right <grammar>in the middle of</grammar> the slurp, and the noodles hit the ceiling. 食事の<reading>最中に</reading>、電話が鳴った。

oyobi.mnemonic_text: Kiki the tree spirit already cradles a sleeping owl. She extends one more twig to a passing bee, calls "<reading>Oh, yo, bee!</reading>", and holds the owl <grammar>as well as</grammar> the bee. 切符<reading>および</reading>荷物を、窓口で見せてください。

ni-taishite.mnemonic_text: Sei and her rival stand face to face on the school sports field, roped knee to knee for the race. She snaps "<reading>Knee tie!</reading>", every glare aimed <grammar>toward</grammar> him. 先生は子供<reading>に対して</reading>優しいです。

nikanshite.mnemonic_text: In the meeting, a quiet worker ties red string from her knee to every page on the desk. The boss whispers "<reading>Knee... can she tie</reading> more?", and every page is tied to one topic, all <grammar>regarding</grammar> her knee. 会議で税金<reading>に関して</reading>話す。

tte.mnemonic_text: Atop the mountain trail, Kaa the crow caws "<reading>Tattle</reading>!" from the vending machine. Then he repeats what the hikers below just said, a <grammar>casual quote</grammar>. 明日は雨だ<reading>って</reading>。

tteba.mnemonic_text: Jin the giant ducks into the kitchen a fourth time and finds his sister Tara still asleep on the rice cooker. He booms "<reading>Tara</reading>!", <grammar>fed up and calling her out</grammar>. 父<reading>ったら</reading>、まだ寝ている。

nikui-yasui.mnemonic_text: Jin jams his knee in Toto's narrow sample door and groans "<reading>knee, ooey</reading>": <grammar>hard to</grammar> get through. At the wide one he grins "<reading>yah, sweet</reading>": <grammar>easy to</grammar> pass. このドアは通り<reading>にくい</reading>。

tsutsu-aru.mnemonic_text: Every night Sho squeezes into his pink <reading>tutu</reading>, and every night it creaks a little tighter. His belly is <grammar>in the process of</grammar> growing. 体重が増え<reading>つつある</reading>。

ageku.mnemonic_text: Ken the shiba knocks down his whole wall of swords, hunting a scratching noise all night. At dawn he lifts the last blade and sighs "<reading>Ah, gecko</reading>": <grammar>after all that, in the end</grammar>, nothing. 三時間探した<reading>あげく</reading>、何もなかった。

wake.mnemonic_text: Han's soup, rice and noodles all arrive cut in exact halves. Sei peeks into his kitchen, sees a wall welded down the middle of his pan, and nods "<reading>Wok, eh?</reading>": <grammar>it makes sense, that's the reason</grammar>. それで半分な<reading>わけだ</reading>。

tokoroga.mnemonic_text: Chuu the mouse bites a perfect-looking taco and squeaks "<reading>Taco? Raw! Gah!</reading>": it looked fine, <grammar>however</grammar> the meat is <grammar>unexpectedly</grammar> raw. <reading>ところが</reading>、肉はまずかった。

soredemo.mnemonic_text: Ken the shiba has four sore paws and an endless shrine lawn, yet he shoves the mower on, panting "<reading>Sore? Then mow!</reading>", and mows <grammar>even so</grammar>. <reading>それでも</reading>、仕事を続けた。

sokode.mnemonic_text: When the school robot freezes mid-bow before the show, Sei cracks her knuckles and says "<reading>So, code!</reading>": <grammar>so, faced with that, she acts</grammar>. <reading>そこで</reading>、私はそれを直した。

sonoseika-de.mnemonic_text: A lion is asleep on the circus ticket booth. The ringmaster points at the empty stool and sighs "<reading>So, no tamer</reading>", and <grammar>because of that</grammar>, no show tonight. <reading>そのため</reading>、彼は学校を休んだ。

kagiri.mnemonic_text: Grandma Kane paints a white boundary line across the shrine road. She yells "<reading>Car, Gary</reading>!" at her nephew, so his car goes <grammar>as far as</grammar> the line and not one inch past. 私の知る<reading>限り</reading>、彼は今日来る。

tatoe-temo.mnemonic_text: The tattoo artist warns Jin that his giant arm will snap every needle in the shop. Jin just holds it out with a shrug, "<reading>Tattoo, eh</reading>? Go ahead", <grammar>even if</grammar> all ten needles break. <reading>たとえ</reading>雨が降っ<reading>ても</reading>、私は行く。

kke.mnemonic_text: Toto the door-to-door turtle knocks on a door he sold last week, forgets the owner's name, and squints, "<reading>Kay</reading>? It was Kay, <grammar>wasn't it</grammar>?" 彼の名前は何だ<reading>っけ</reading>。

noda.mnemonic_text: Dai, the giant baby, wails an earthquake across town. Asked why, he points at the bump on his forehead, "<reading>No duh</reading>", because <grammar>the thing is</grammar>, he hit his head. 頭が痛い<reading>んだ</reading>。

koso.mnemonic_text: At Grandma Kane's shrine the bell rope is chewed through. Kaa the crow flies past forty cats, lands on one and cries "<reading>Caw, so</reading>!": <grammar>precisely</grammar> that cat, <grammar>for sure</grammar>. あの猫<reading>こそ</reading>悪いです。

sae.mnemonic_text: Jin hauls a fridge up the mountain trail and, at the vending machine on top, gasps "<reading>Say</reading>..." with not <grammar>even</grammar> one more word left in him. 言葉<reading>さえ</reading>出ません。

saeba.mnemonic_text: Chuu the mouse gazes up at a cheese wheel taller than a door. He sighs "A <reading>saber</reading>!": <grammar>if only</grammar> he had one, the whole wheel would be his. ナイフ<reading>さえ</reading>あれ<reading>ば</reading>、食べられます。

nomi.mnemonic_text: A customer wanders toward the staff room at Koichi's konbini. Koichi vaults the onigiri shelf yelling "<reading>No, me!</reading>": that door is for him <grammar>only</grammar>. この部屋は私<reading>のみ</reading>使えます。

wakeganai.mnemonic_text: Chuu the tiny mouse ties a leash to Jin the giant's ankle and tugs hard. Jin just booms "<reading>Walk a guy? Nay!</reading>", since <grammar>there's no way</grammar> a mouse walks a giant. 彼が来る<reading>わけがない</reading>。

hodo.mnemonic_text: Han holds a ruler against his rising bread dough. The instant it touches the line he barks "<reading>Hold, dough!</reading>", and it rises only <grammar>to the extent of</grammar> that mark. 今日は昨日<reading>ほど</reading>暑くない。

kurai-degree.mnemonic_text: After ten years of knocking, Toto the turtle sells his first door. He wails "I could <reading>cry</reading>!" and floods the doorstep, happy <grammar>to the extent that</grammar> tears pour off his shell. 泣く<reading>くらい</reading>嬉しかった。

dake-de-naku.mnemonic_text: Sho the tiny magician tips his hat and out climbs a doc, then a cook, so he bows and squeaks "<reading>Doc, then a cook</reading>": <grammar>not only</grammar> a doctor, <grammar>but also</grammar> lunch. この本は安い<reading>だけでなく</reading>、面白いです。

kagirazu.mnemonic_text: Kaa the crow scorches a neat boundary around his crows-only picnic. Two giraffes step over it anyway, and the flock caws "<reading>Kaa, giraffes</reading>", since the guest list is <grammar>not limited to</grammar> crows. 子供<reading>に限らず</reading>、大人も漫画を読む。

ippou-de.mnemonic_text: A hippo plops onto one side of the riverbank seesaw, and Chuu the mouse on the other side sails over the trees squeaking "<reading>Hippo day</reading>". Great for her; <grammar>on the other hand</grammar>, bad for mice. 兄はよく働く<reading>一方で</reading>、弟はよく遊ぶ。

nitotte.mnemonic_text: Jin the giant holds up the knit tote Grandma Kane made him, pinched between two fingers like a stamp. "<reading>Knit tote</reading>," he says kindly: huge <grammar>for her</grammar>, tiny <grammar>from where he stands</grammar>. 日本語は私<reading>にとって</reading>面白い。

hoka-nai.mnemonic_text: Jin searches the shed for another spade and finds nothing else, only one doll-sized hoe. He holds it up, sighs "<reading>Hoe, can I</reading>", and <grammar>has no choice but to</grammar> dig with it. これを使う<reading>ほかない</reading>。

yoruni.mnemonic_text: Chuu sails across Dai's bathtub on the giant baby's floating knee and salutes his "<reading>knee yacht</reading>". Whether he stays dry <grammar>depends on</grammar> that knee. 天気<reading>によって</reading>変わる。

tsuide-ni.mnemonic_text: Ken trots up the mountain trail to the vending machine for a drink and, <grammar>while he is at it</grammar>, buys one more cold can to roll on his leg, panting "<reading>Sweaty knee</reading>!" 買い物の<reading>ついでに</reading>、パンを買う。

ue-de.mnemonic_text: At the riverbank, Han reads the depth sign to the very end, climbs on top of it, and only <grammar>after</grammar> that check calls "<reading>Wade</reading>!" before stepping in. 考えた<reading>上で</reading>、決めます。

suruto.mnemonic_text: Grandma Kane's bedtime story never changes: "<reading>Sue rode</reading> the goat up the shrine steps, <grammar>and then</grammar> the goat rode Sue." <reading>すると</reading>、猫が私に乗った。

igai.mnemonic_text: Han the chef counts his dinner guests, finds one muddy boar in a bow tie and shrieks "<reading>Eee, guy!</reading>" He shoves the boar outside, and every guest <grammar>except</grammar> him gets soup. 魚<reading>以外</reading>は食べます。

igo-formal.mnemonic_text: At harvest, a stalk of rye blew into Kaa the crow's ear. <grammar>Ever since</grammar>, he has sat on his power line puffing little flames at it and croaking "<reading>Ear rye</reading>, still there." 日本に来て<reading>以来</reading>、ここに住んでいます。

hantai-ni.mnemonic_text: At the wedding, every guest knots a tie at the neck. Jin the giant, <grammar>on the contrary</grammar>, knots his around one huge knee and booms "<reading>Hun, tie knee!</reading>" <reading>反対に</reading>、弟は肉が好きです。
